about.heading: Adv.Shikha Mishra, Attorney at Law
about.bio1: I have been dedicated to providing exceptional legal representation to clients. With a focus on Criminal Law, Matrimonial Law, Divorce, Family law & civil litigation, I bring a wealth of knowledge and a commitment to achieving the best possible outcomes for those I serve.
about.bio2: After graduating with from SDSM Law School, I honed my skills at one of Sawale most prestigious law firms before establishing my own practice. My approach combines thorough legal analysis with a personalized touch, ensuring that each client receives tailored solutions to their unique legal challenges.
